title: Fireworks Quiet-Down Time by Neighborhood
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fireworks:noise
| search last_noise_hour=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(last_noise_hour) as avg_last_noise_hour max(last_noise_hour) as max_last_noise_hour by _time zone_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks time fireworks settle down over time and breaks it out by neighborhood.
value: Quiet-down time helps set realistic expectations for pets, children, and sleep planning.
implementation: Send time fireworks settle down events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of time fireworks settle down by neighborhood.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how time fireworks settle down changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
